title: The Night the Moon Returns Home
description: The Moon-Prayer Night has come. On this final night, what memories will she leave behind?

mainQuestExcel.title: The Night the Moon Returns Home
mainQuestExcel.description: The Moon-Prayer Night has come. On this final night, what memories will she leave behind?

dialogs.text: This feels like... the surprise of my life.
Do you like it?
I do. I never imagined I'd ever get to enjoy Moon-Prayer Night with everyone so freely...
Hehe, if you're happy, we're happy!

Quite a strategy you came up with — hide the tree in the forest... It's not your usual style, Lauma. Is there something about Moon-Prayer Night that enhances what's in your head as well as the antlers on top?
Apparently so. It even inspired a perennial penny pincher to use their resources for a greater cause. It truly is a magical festival.
(I see it now. This bickering is actually a sign of a strong relationship.)
Huh? What's everyone doing here?
Oh! Miss Columbina! You're back!
Yes. I'm fine now... thanks for your concern.
How's your progress with Alice's assignment?
Very well indeed. I've never heard her sound so excited.
Isn't she always quite excitable?
Not like this... This time, her excitement seems more serious. Seems like she's had a major breakthrough.
She said she'll contact us once she knows more. In the meantime, we're free to relax and have some fun.
Enjoy the time off while it lasts. I have a feeling that our next task won't be so simple.
Mm... I should go. I still have a few things to attend to at the Frostmoon Scions' stall.
And I think I'll take a look around. With any luck, this once-in-a-year festival will come with once-in-a-year opportunities.
Hold up a second, where's Varka?
I believe he made a beeline for The Flagship the moment he entered Nasha Town.
Ah. That's Mondstadters for you — they know what they want when festivals roll around...
Goodbye for now, Columbina. I hope you have a wonderful night.
I will.
Hehe, well in that case, don't just stand there — get out there and have some fun! You'll definitely get a warm welcome at every stall!
Oh, also — take this map with you. It's a guide to the festival.
The Frostmoon Scions' stall is over here. Lauma's invited a whole bunch of cute animals to celebrate too.
Over there is the Hexenzirkel section. Alice seemed more excited than anyone about this festival, so she insisted on making it a grand affair.
Oh, and then there's the Nasha Town local specialties, including... actually, forget that, better if you go check them out for yourself!
Thank you. It looks like a lot of fun.
Enjoy your Moon-Prayer Night.
You're not coming with me?
We'll be around! But don't you wanna browse by yourself for a bit first?
Um...
It's fine, don't worry.
Yup! If you find something you like and wanna try it out together, just give us a shout — we'll be right with you!
Otherwise, just relax and enjoy yourself! There's so much on offer, so try to experience as much as you can... and don't forget to stuff yourself with all the delicious festival food!
We'll probably run into each other while we're browsing.
Haha. Alright, then... Off I go.
Have fun!
We'll be nearby.
(Wow. The Frostmoon Scions' stall looks kinda plain, but it's pretty cool once you get into it.)
(I don't go to Hiisi Island much, but it's got that, like... "olde worlde" cultural feel.)
(Heh, and if culture means we get more festivals, I'm all for it!)
Hello, Jahoda.
Whoa! Columbin— Uhh, hello, Moon Goddess!
(That was too close! I almost gave the game away in front of the staff! ...Wait, what's the deal with her shoes? They don't make a sound when she walks! I could do with a pair of those...)
Do you like balloons too?
Balloons? Oh... you mean those.
(What's so fun about balloons? I'm not a kid anymore... They're probably more up Aino's alley.)
Yes. The animals seem very curious about these strange flying objects. I was drawn here by their voices.
I recently learned a fun new game you can play with balloons, so I decided to come and give it a try.
A new game...?
Hello.
Ah, welcome home, Moon Goddess. Here to buy some balloons?
Yes. Could you give me a few that haven't been inflated yet?
Hmm? Are you sure? ...I guess it's not a problem, but...
Yes please. Thank you.
(Uninflated balloons? But those are just... little rubber pouches. What does she want with those?)
Would you like to play the balloon game, Jahoda?
Huh? Uh, sure, I guess? How do you play it...?
Wait here a moment.
Oh...
(Ugh... This is so weird. What have I gotten myself into now?)
Hmm? I thought I saw Columbina nearby.
(Uh-oh! That's... The Fourth Harbinger! ...Although, she's helped us out quite a bit. She's good people, right?)
(Is she looking for Columbina? Phew. Guess that's my ticket out of here. I'm not sure my heart can take being sandwiched between two Harbingers!)
(Which stall is she checking out? Oh, it's that other Frostmoon Scions one — try on the headgear, see what it's like having antlers or animal ears for a day.)
(I wouldn't be caught dead wearing that stuff... So embarrassing. I have enough gear to carry as it is...)
(Wait, what!? She put it on!?)
(...How peculiar. This would take some getting used to... I wonder if this is what it's like for Lynette?)
It really suits you, Ma'am.
(What is this? She was so intimidating a moment ago, but now... Dang, she's really rockin' those ears! How does she make 'em look so cool?)
(Hmph... I suppose I may as well keep them on for now. All part of the festive experience.)
Hmm?
(She's coming this way!)
How do you do, Miss Jahoda?
(Oh geez, don't talk to me while wearing that thing! Where am I supposed to look!?)
Oh, uh... Hey there.
I'm looking for Columbina. Have you seen her?
Ah, sh—she, she just... Huh!?
Hehe.
(W—W—Wait, is THAT what she meant by "balloon game"—)
...Hyah!
No fair, how come I get caught in the crossfire!?
An ambush from the rear? Is this a declaration of war, Columbina?
Would you like to play too, Arlecchino?
(Seriously!? Are they gonna start some beef right here, right now?)
Gladly. That said, I believe there is another who would like to join.
...! Boss! Boss Nef! Thank goodness! You've gotta get me outta here, things are kicking off big time!
Hello there. I'd like ten... No, make that twenty balloons, please. Uninflated.
...Huh?
Miss Moon Goddess, I hope you're prepared to pay the price for assaulting my employee?
Haha. Welcome to the game, Nefer.
Just to be clear, let's keep this a fair fight, okay? No strange powers, please and thank you.
Naturally.
Hmm? Don't just stand there, Jahoda — aren't you going to team up with me?
Huh? Do I have to?
Of course. Don't forget, the Curatorium has a reputation to uphold.
...I knew something like this was gonna happen!
Welcome home, Moon Goddess. Would you like to try on some animal-themed headwear?
(Ah... I always hear Lauma saying how heavy her antlers are. I wonder how it feels?)
(Let me give it a try...)
Oh my, it really suits you!
(It's a little itchy, and it's hard to turn my head...)
(Should I keep wearing it?)
I'll keep it on.
Alright! Feel free to come back if you change your mind!
I'll try a different one...
How does this look...?
I think I want to remove it for now.
...Sunny days! I prefer sunny days!
Aw, well you are as warm as the sun itself, Moon Goddess.
Very well, I believe your spirit animal has to be...
...This most adorable Chic Badger.
Wow! Thank you, Mister Talking Magic Lamp!
Haha. Have a very happy festival, Moon Goddess.
Flins? That's you, isn't it?
#Shh. It's our little secret, my dear {NICKNAME} and Paimon.
Uh... Okay, sure, but... Why are you here selling sugar sculptures?
Everyone celebrates in their own way. After gazing into the Abyss and spending time around gravestones all year, what better way to relax than to see sunny smiles on the faces of the living?
Besides that, I like to think of myself as a fair judge of character. I daresay matching personalities to confections suits me rather well.
That's not what Paimon was talking about! Aren't you afraid that your true identity might be exposed?
Hmm? Should I be? There is all manner of magic in the air this Moon-Prayer Night, thanks to the work of the great mages.
I see Miss Columbina is hiding in plain sight — why should I not do the same? Why miss this rare opportunity to enjoy a special evening in my true form?
Fair enough, you've got a point there. People who don't know you will probably think you're just a talking lantern.
Haha... Well, now that we see eye to eye, what brings you here? Not a search for your spirit animal, I presume?
Ah, well actually... Here, see for yourself!
Oh, this is... how wonderful. A beautiful idea.
Yeah. We just met Varka, and he said that having everyone draw their own section was kinda boring... so he did your bit for you.
Haha... Ah, Varka. Ever the maverick. I see his artistic skills are... truly one of a kind.
In that case, I shall paint something on Mr. Albedo's behalf in a short while.
What? Why not now?
...Ahem. Welcome home, Moon Goddess.
(...! That was close...)
Hello, Flins.
...She recognized you right away!
Haha, what keen eyes you have, Miss Columbina... Um, especially considering they are shut.
I did not see you. Rather, I sensed you. I can sense the fluctuations in kuuvahki all around me.
One would expect no less of the Moon Goddess. Might I interest you in some candy?
Yes, please.
Excellent, I shall make some for you right away.
...Hmm?
Something the matter, Miss Columbina?
...What about my "spirit animal"? All the other children carrying sugar sculptures are talking about it.
(Wait, is she taking the test seriously?)
Ah, my apologies. How could I neglect that?
You are quite right, Miss Columbina. Every one of us has a magical creature living in their heart. Would you permit me to help you find yours?
Yes, please.
...Do you prefer the day, or the night?
Night.
Which of the four seasons is your favorite?
Winter.
Think of a perfect day. What is the weather like? Sunny? Rainy? Or perhaps, cloudy?
Rainy in the morning, sunny at night.
(...What kind of answer is that!?)
Forests, lakes, and open seas — which do you prefer of these?
I like them all.
Imagine you opened your very own shop. What would you sell there?
Hmm... Moonlight, I think.
(Wow. Paimon would totally shop there.)
How much would it sell for?
It wouldn't cost anything. You'd just need to visit.
Aha. I believe I know what your spirit animal is...
Here. For you.
Ooh, it's a kuuhenki!
Indeed. A free-spirited being with a deep love for all things here in Nod-Krai, who selflessly lends her aid to as many people as she can reach.
It is the perfect fit for you, Miss Columbina.
Heh. Thank you.
Flins...
#Haha. It would be my honor, {NICKNAME}.
But you shall have to forgive me. We have known each other for quite some time... I doubt there is any answer I could give that would come as a surprise to you.
So, instead... would you accept this sugar sculpture as a token of our friendship?
It's a lantern...
Um... Heyyy, uh, why don't you two go enjoy your candy over there? Paimon wants to try out this "spirit animal" thing too! Right, Flins?
(C'mon, play ball, gotta get this drawing done!)
But I want to hear Paimon's answers...
Ah! But... it'll probably take ages! Paimon's a... complex soul! Uhh... And we don't want your candy to melt while you wait, huh?
Oh... Okay then.
Phew...
Nice excuse, Lady Paimon. That was some quick thinking.
Yeah, no thanks to you! A little help next time?
#(It's sweet... Is that... Lakkaberry? I wonder what flavor {NICKNAME} got...)
This way, this way! It's the candy-selling lantern!
I'm coming!
(Ah! Of course...)
#{NICKNAME}, maybe we can share?
...Share?
Yes. I found out recently that people share their food sometimes, so I'd like to try it. Or... is that a no?
Oh, no, we can do that...
Thank you.
Hmm... Yours is a little more sour than mine. Here, you try it.
I'll just have a little nibble...
Are you sure?
Haha... Amazing...
What is?
My sugar sculpture has shrunk, yet my heart is filled with feelings of sweetness.
...I will remember this feeling.
Would you like another bite?
Sure.
Don't mind if I do!
Just, uh, don't take too big of a bite...
Now I wanna give this a try...
"I wish for a never-ending supply of Lakkaberries..."
What a humble wish. Probably written by a child...
Hmm? Is that Lauma the Moonchanter...?
"I wish that the Longplume Ibises would stop biting me..."
Oh dear. Poor Lauma...
Alright. I'll write that one down for you.
Mm-hmm. I got it.
While everyone else is celebrating Moon-Prayer Night, you're as busy as ever...
I don't mind. It's rewarding work. A good kind of busy.
My antlers are at their heaviest tonight, and the kuuvahki waves are especially strong...
But as I help these dear friends hang their wishes up, I feel a great peace within myself that is hard to describe.
You see? They are all such beautiful wishes.
...And they are ones that we can fulfill by our own strength.
Do you blame me, Lauma? I want to hear your honest answer.
It is by the help of so many people that I can return to the moon... But I feel as though I've hardly done anything in return.
You've done plenty, Columbina.
I say this in earnest, both as someone who knows your history... and also as a friend, who has seen what you've been through.
What about as a Moonchanter?
Hah... I feel proud to honor our Moon Goddess's wish, and I'm sure any Moonchanter in history would have felt the same way.
Thank you for your kind words, Lauma.
But...
Hmm?
...Since you asked for my honesty, I won't lie to you. My feelings are mixed right now. Besides pride, I also feel...
I suppose it's... a reluctance to let go.
Once you return to the moon, we will be far apart, and separated by a false sky.
I'm sure those of us left behind will gaze up at that sky, yearning for the moon once in a while... just as you used to do.
I will miss you, Lauma. I will miss you all.
Hmm...
I hope to stay in touch. I will try and find some way to send messages down from the moon.
Perhaps you could use kuuvahki?
I've heard Jahoda say that signals can be sent using long and short waves, or strong and weak lights.
Hmm... That sounds a little complicated. What if we forget what the signals mean?
We could prepare a codebook beforehand, but... Heh, you're right. It wouldn't really suit you.
Still, whatever happens, I believe that you will find your own unique way of communicating with us.
And now that I think about that, my heart feels lighter.
Because you trust in me?
Yes, I have faith in you, and in the power of truth.
In my experience, the truth tends to be difficult. But that's what makes it stand out from what is false.
So, I'm confident that your thoughts and your love will shine through the curtain of lies. We will know it when we see it.
Thank you... Now, could you help me hang up my wish?
Is this...
I wish that all who dwell in this moonlit world can find a place to belong, and I wish that I shall one day see my friends again.
It's two wishes... I hope that's not too greedy of me?
Not at all. And I think you speak for us all with the second one.
I shall continue to pray until the day that all of these wishes come true.
Dodoco's Whirly Gig! Come check out Dodoco's Whirly Gig!
Ah, welcome home, Moon Goddess.
Might I ask what this is?
Ah, it's a very special amusement sponsored by the great mage herself! Ride on a soft and furry Dodoco, and embark on an unforgettable adventure!
(I say that, but I'm just following a script, here... Who is this mage, anyway? And what the heck's a Dodoco?)
I'd like to ride.
No problem. But, uh... are you by yourself?
Is that not okay?
Oh, no, it's fine. It's just that each Dodoco can accommodate two passengers. Would you like to bring a friend along?
My friends...
...That should do it. Now we just need to get everyone else to draw something on it too.
But we gotta keep it a secret from Columbina...
#...{NICKNAME}.
Um, yes?
I want to go on that ride. Will you join me?
(A spinning Dodoco? Ah, I see. It's a ride for two.)
Sure.
Let's go, then.
Uh, one moment!
(...Don't worry! Paimon will do the rounds. You go have fun!)
(Thanks, Paimon!)
Hmm...?
...Nothing!
Alright. I think we have to wait in line over there...
Please take your seats. For safety reasons, you mustn't try to leave the ride before it comes to a complete stop.
Alright, you're all set! I wish you both a wonderful journey!
(You can always rely on Alice for weird and wonderful gadgets...)
What did you think?
Not bad... It reminds me of riding a Moonlane.
Sometimes, the kuuhenki circle around me like this, playing their beautiful melodies.
Aw. That sounds so sweet.
Yeah. I'm going to miss them.
(I wonder what Columbina will find on the moon? ...Perhaps even she doesn't know...)
Does it... scare you at all?
...It does.
I've felt scared in the past, too. But this is a little different.
...You know something? I got to see a lot of fascinating things during my "disappearance."
I saw how the Frostmoon Scions act around their families... so different than how they used to act in my presence. And I also saw how they interact with their friends.
It made me curious at first. Why do people act so sincere when they're worshiping gods, but save their truest, warmest feelings for each other?
Slowly, I came to realize that... it's because they trust one another. They know, deep down, that they'll be accepted for who they are — all of it, the good and the bad.
Your friends accept all of you, too.
I know. I knew it the moment you started calling out my name.
What I fear now is the end... I fear losing all this the very night I have gained it.
You won't lose us...
Hmm...?
Even after you return to the moon...
Thank you for this conversation... Thank you for listening to me.
Don't worry. This fear I have, and the unknown that awaits me — they cannot hurt me. Not when I possess a treasure far greater.
I just... want you to remember this version of me, the real me, on this final night together.
Dear passengers, Dodoco's awesome adventure has come to a close. Please leave in an orderly fashion, and we look forward to seeing you again in the future!
...Hmm? Don't want the journey to end, huh?
Don't worry, you two. There's always another adventure waiting just around the corner.
Your friends will still be here.
Let's go.
Remarkable talent!
It's not too easy, is it? Still, I'm sure you'll familiarize yourself with Jumpy Dumpty's attack range in no time!
So, what do you make of it?
The use of Jumpy Dumpties doesn't come as naturally to me as kuuvahki. But their unpredictability makes it fun.
I think they call this... novelty?
Indeed! And how did it feel, blowing those pesky nuisances away?
Not bad.
Any guilt?
Hmm? What do you mean?
Wonderful! Lovely answers to all three questions. You've passed the safety test! Now, I can give this special bomb to you as a souvenir.
Remember, if you find any meanies living on the moon, you can use this to boom them into oblivion!
I will.
...I wouldn't say it's "unfair," exactly.
I mean, your voice goes right into peoples' heads. How would you explain that to the kids?
You can't just explain it away as magic...
Is something the matter?
Ah, Miss Columbina! No, nothing you need to worry yourself about...
Ah, impeccable timing! Stick around for a second, Miss Columbina. I need your input on something.
This self-proclaimed knight of justice has yet to give me a satisfactory answer. I, for one, would like to hear your verdict on the matter.
Ahem... Hey now, I left The Flagship just to help you out, Ms. Nicole...
Are you okay?
So, Alice and I are both using long-range remote control spells that work on similar principles, allowing us to attend this festive fair in Dodoco form...
Sorry, let me backtrack a little — while similar, there are some key differences.
Alice, being a great mage, wanted her Dodoco to reflect something of her own charm and mystique, so she adjusted the way its tail moves when it spins around.
An entirely gratuitous move, in my opinion. I hardly see how anyone is going to notice that.
If anything, I'd say that anyone who stares intently enough at a Dodoco's tail to notice such a small detail is someone we ought to be highly concerned about.

I only say this to emphasize that my question has nothing to do with tails. Now that we're clear on that... Why is Alice's Dodoco permitted to interact directly with the children celebrating Moon-Prayer Night, while mine is not?
Your voice speaks directly into people's minds...
See? Exactly what I said.
Ms. Nicole?
Ugh... I can't stand it!
I know, that probably makes me sound like a whiny child acting out in front of their parents... hmm, and it's a little embarrassing now that I think about it...
But hey, I've said it now. I can't take it back — that would be even more embarrassing!
...Also, don't go reading too much into that analogy. It was off the top of my head. I'm actually an awful lot older than either of you...
Ms. Nicole, are you saying that you'd like someone to play the game you've prepared?
Eh, I'm not so invested in that. It's just something cobbled together using items I borrowed from Alice. She probably didn't even make them herself.
The point is, I want to know everyone's thoughts after they receive their prizes! But as you've said, I can't just ask...
I've been biting my lip for so long! And I've had no one to vent my frustrations on.
*sigh* I thought this was going to be a nice, straightforward festival where I'd get the chance to guide people to treasure...
Well, can I play? I can't guarantee that I'll win a prize, but...
You will?
I'd like to try.
Then what are we waiting for? Let the game begin!
(...It's like they forgot I was ever here. Hahaha.)
I know, that probably makes me sound like...
a whiny child acting out in front of their parents...
Hmm, and it's a little embarrassing
now that I think about it...
But hey, I've said it now...
I can't take it back —
That would be even more embarrassing!
Congratulations, Miss Columbina! With your great wisdom, you have overcome every obstacle in your path and conquered the great challenge posed to you by Fate.
Fate?
Well, something to that effect. If you'd prefer something more poetic, it could be... "the icy winds," or "the dawn"... anything you like, really.
...You could even go with "the challenge posed to you by Dodoco," if that's what you're into. Anyway, you can take or leave my suggestions. Moving on...
All my hopes are now resting on this.
Can I... open it now?
Stop teasing me! Please, I'm begging you — no more talk, just open it.
Wow... What a lovely sculpture. Classic and cute at the same time... Thank you, Ms. Nicole. I'll always treasure it.
Ahhhh, there we go... Music to my ears...
You have my sincerest gratitude, Miss Columbina.
Thank you for sharing your precious time with me and fulfilling my wish.
Don't mention it.
You've all done much to help me, and still I'm the one receiving all these gifts...
Welcome home, Moon Goddess.
Oh? You're the genuine article. Alice was right. This Moon-Prayer Night was worth watching after all.
Another one that talks...
Greetings, pleased to make your acquaintance. I am the Hexenzirkel member they call "B" — Barbeloth Trismegistus.
Columbina Hyposelenia. Pleased to meet you too.
Hyposelenia... Mm, a fine name indeed.
Now then, Miss Columbina... Do you wish to hear a mage's divination?
Divination... The Frostmoon Scions used to ask me what would happen in the future. Is this like that?
From the perspective of the one seeking answers, perhaps.
As you look to your journey ahead, if you seek to understand the unknown, resolve your doubts, and soothe the confusion in your heart... Divination could be for you.
The unknowns on my journey...
Of course, if one wishes to peer into "fate," then hydromancy is the more precise option.

But that is a complex affair, and to relegate that majestic art to the status of a festive amusement would seem somewhat uncouth. Besides... it is sometimes better to not know "fate" with great certainty.
Hence, I shall use the suitably festive Lunar Arcana to tell your fortune instead. It is more popular with the youth in any case.
Lunar Arcana...
Indeed. Unlike hydromancy, this will only display possibilities and trends.
People like think of themselves as creatures of agency and free will. Peering too far and too clearly into the future is detrimental to both body and soul.
I'd like to give it a try.
Of course you may. Come then. Take a seat, Miss Columbina.
Before we begin... Are there any specific questions you would like to ask?
Hmm... Let's stick to general possibilities and trends, like you suggested.
Ah, very well. Then I shall use the basic Lunar Arcana deck.
Now, try to relax. Cast your mind upon the things you have experienced, and the things you are soon to experience. I will shuffle the deck.
Would you like to the cut the cards yourself?
...You do it.
No problem. Now then, to make things easier for the seeker — that is to say, you — I shall decipher the cards from your perspective.
Please, draw the first Lunar Arcana. This represents "destiny," and is the foundation for the divination as a whole.
Now, draw your second card. This will stand for the "past," the sum of all your experiences that have come before.
And now the third Arcana. This is the "present," your interpretation of the current moment.
Finally, the last card. This shall speak of the "future," which... Oh?
Hmm? A... kuuvahki pulse?
Fascinating. I've never encountered this before in my role as a diviner. Something has exerted an influence upon this card, causing it to leave its designated position.
What do you make of this, Miss Columbina? Perhaps this is the guiding hand of fate in action.
Of course, if you wish, you can choose to deny the validity of this card and draw the "future" for yourself.
...No, it's fine. Let's go with this one.
A bold decision. I must say, I'm looking forward to the results.
Well then. Let us flip the Lunar Arcana in sequence, and see what emerges.
Sure.
First, "destiny." Ah, no surprises here. The card that represents yours is "The Moon."
The Moon...
Indeed. The moon can represent the truth at some times, but deception at others. False peace, destructive calamity, and the world-changing power that lies within.
When the Moon is placed on the destiny tile, it indicates that your destiny is not what it may appear on the surface. Instead, it may yet have a hidden side.
It symbolizes a journey through the fog, fraught with uncertainty and deception, where one must face inner challenges head on.
I don't understand...
Haha, patience, my dear. This is but the first card, which serves as a basis for the interpretations that follow. Our divination will only grow clearer from here on out.
Now then. Flip the second card, the one that speaks for the "past."
Ah, "The Hermit"... but inverted.
Inverted?
Yes. "The Hermit" symbolizes solitude, introspection, and the pursuit of truth. When inverted, it represents isolation, truth out of reach, and a path that leads one astray.
Combined with "The Moon" as one's destiny, "The Hermit" inverted represents...
A choice you made to stand alone in the past. It was a choice made not out of fear or arrogance, but for reasons that others could not perceive.
You fumbled through the darkness without a guide. But you did not find your way... rather, you went astray — more than once, it would seem.
(Is this about how I became Kuutar despite not wishing to become a god? And how I joined the Fatui because I yearned for a place to belong?)
I suspect only you know the answer to this question.
All is not lost. The past is in the past, and so shall it remain. Shall we look into the "present" now?
Oh my, "The Lovers." One of the most interesting Lunar Arcana.
What does this one mean?
This means that you have had an unprecedented emotional experience. The joy of finding your soul becoming intertwined with that of another... A precious and wonderful thing indeed.
It's true. I've made a lot of friends recently, and they are very good to me. I like them a lot.
That sounds lovely. I am most delighted for you. "The Lovers" can also represent important decisions, perhaps related to a parting of ways. Now, if I were to guess...
Yes... My return to the moon...
I understand. Parting with friends is never easy, Columbina.
But rest assured, this is not the end of your journey. There is always another story waiting to be told. The "future" always lies ahead.
The "future"...
Hehe. Well now, it's finally time to flip this most mysterious of cards. Why did it appear? And what does it wish to tell you?
I'm ready.
Very well. Flip this card and see what lies on the other side...
Oh...
Miss Barbeloth? What is it?
...This card is "Death."
That doesn't sound very good.
It depends on how we interpret it.
It is true that it can represent an agonizing death, a complete and utter end. But at the same time, it can also represent rebirth.
Do not forget that your destiny card is "The Moon." That lends your future many different potential meanings.
If death spells the end... is it unavoidable?
As I have said, divination can only display general trends. It is a rough guide, but it does not show predetermined outcomes.
Allow me to summarize it for you.
In the past, you may have lost your way, but now, you have gained new connections and new strength.

I'm gonna come back a whole lot stronger! Be ready for a rematch!

Meow~

Meow~

Meow~

Brother, I've just been through a breakup... Console me, brother. Ease my aching heart.

So I thought... but alas, 'twas but the scent of dirt in the ground.
Oh yeah? Well, I'm sorry, but it sounds like your dumb nose is playing tricks on you.
How many times do I have to tell you? When you spin around, look up at the moon! The MOON, got it? Not at me! Do I look like a moon to you!?

Dori?

But with your sharp eye— I mean, sharp skills, I'm sure you'll win all the prizes in one fell swoop!

Hmph, let her go up there and cry alone. See if I care...
Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?
You're giving me candy? ...That isn't like you. This had better not be some weird prank...
Hmm... coffee flavor? I thought you hated coffee... Mm, it's extra-strong, too. Hah! You didn't do all this just for me, did you...?
Hey, hey! Don't take it away! I never said I didn't want it. I mean, you can't unmake the candy now...
Assorted Moon-Prayer Candy! All your favorite flavors in a box! Alright, kids, just line up over here...
Hmph. I'm never playing games with you ever again, Ineffa!
Aino is throwing a tantrum again... I believe it will take three krumkakes to constitute a suitable peace offering.
Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?
Ooh, Moon-Prayer Candy! Sweet! Is it okay if I grab a whole bunch?
Psst, Columbina, turn around! Use your huge cloak to block Ineffa's vision!
Yum! Ooh, and this one's even yummier...
Ugh... The flavors are blending in my mouth... Eww...
Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?
Scanning candy composition and ingredient ratios...
Selection confirmed. I would like the krumkake-flavor.
...Flavor profile simulates real krumkakes with 27% accuracy. This is a non-viable substitute for Aino's afternoon snack.
One moment, please.
Done. Please sample this freshly-baked krumkake, Miss Columbina.
Aino is throwing a tantrum again... I believe it will take three krumkakes to constitute a suitable peace offering.
Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?
Scanning candy composition and ingredient ratios...
Selection confirmed. I would like the krumkake-flavor.
...Flavor profile simulates real krumkakes with 27% accuracy. This is a non-viable substitute for Aino's afternoon snack.
One moment, please.
Done. Please sample this freshly-baked krumkake, Miss Columbina.
...Ugh. I really thought you were gonna send me home...
Where did you learn to scare people, huh? Bad! Bad Ineffa!
Do you see this, Aino?
It's a krumkake! You made it yourself, didn't you? Wait. How did you know I was hungry?
Correction: You are not hungry. You merely desire food.
However, consuming extraneous snacks is acceptable during a festival. Come, celebrate Moon-Prayer Night, Aino.
Yay! You're the best, Ineffa! Festivals. Are. Awesome!
C'mon, Citrus, one more round! Just one more!
But my neck— ah! Oof... It's acting up again...
You should take a break. Health comes first.
Yeah, don't push yourself. We'll find someone else!
Hey, don't look at me. I'm just the referee.
What are we gonna do, then?
Do you need any help?
Yes we do. We need one more player for our game.
Alright. Could you teach me how to play?
It's really simple. You just throw the dice and move by that number of tiles. First one to reach the finish line wins.
Rolling a hamster means you move one step forward, a paper frog is two steps, and a flying squirrel is three steps — 'cuz they go the fastest.
Okay, I get it.
So we're all set?
In that case, please take your places... and let the game begin!
(What is going on over here? It looks like fun...)
Hold it right there! You can't run away from me, Moon Goddess!
Hmm? Are you talking to me?
Of course! Do you see anyone else here dressed up as the moon goddess besides me and you? Hey, c'mon, call me by my title!
Happy Moon-Prayer Night, Moon Goddess.
Hehe, and the same to you!
Anyway, there's no time to waste. Get ready... for the duel of a lifetime!
Um... a duel?
Meet my partner, Stacko. Come on out, Stacko!
Don't just stand there! Let's see your partner!
Partner...?
Pee-weeet!
Hmm? ...So I need to select a partner and command them in battle?
Partner... I need a partner...
Beep.
Whoa, am I seeing things? Where'd you get a kuuhenki!? They're super rare!
That's great — buuuut, you can only bring one partner to battle against me and Stacko. No ganging up allowed!
(They all look so eager to be picked... Hmm... Which one should I choose?)
The light and floaty kuuhenki.
(This one usually lives in Nasha Town. She likes falling asleep to the sound of striking hammers... And I bet she's quite familiar with robots' weak spots.)
The majestic Rimehorn Deer.
(This deer came to celebrate the festival with the Frostmoon Scions. It wants to help me with its antlers — they are its pride and joy...)
The adorable robot.
(I'm not sure what this bot is trying to say, but it seems very happy. That bow... does it want to dress up as the Moon Goddess, too?)
(Hmm, I wanna give this some more thought.)
Alright. I choose you.
Testing, testing... This is an emergency broadcast — an exciting battle is about to take place right here at the Nasha Town special arena!
In this corner, we have the Moon Goddess and her robot partner...
And in the other, we have... the Moon Goddess and her kuuhenki partner.
And in the other, we have... the Moon Goddess and her Rimehorn Deer partner.
And in the other, we have... the Moon Goddess and her... other robot partner.
(Gah, this announcer stuff is harder than I thought! Why does everything I say sound so dumb? If I could cringe any harder, I'd fold in on myself!)
Only one Moon Goddess can be victorious in this ultimate battle of destiny! But who will it be? There's only one way to find out!
Now, without further ado... Let the battle of the moons begin!
I don't care who we're up against — Stacko and I ain't gonna lose!
Beep-beep!
Let's strike first! Stacko, "Formation Shift"!
Ohh! The robot has kicked things off with a change of formation. But how will this affect the battle? Nobody knows!
Attack.
The other party chooses to attack! Let's see how their partner performs!
Beep.
Stacko...!
The attack lands! And if those sizzling sounds are anything to go by, it was very effective!
Okay then... Stacko, maintain formation, and enter your empowered state!
Empowered state! There we go, now we're talking!
Absorbing the immense kuuvahki present on Moon-Prayer Night, this lean mean machine has greatly increased its offensive power!
Attack.
Good choice! Buffs count for nothing if you beat 'em before they can use it!
Beep.
It's a hit! But Stacko stands firm...
The battle is heating up, fast! I'm about to start sweating machine oil over here!
Go for it, Stacko! Set kuuvahki to maximum!
Can their opponents withstand this blow? And what will this Moon Goddess do?
Don't be afraid. Fight however you wish.
It's... it's a Moonlane!
A deft use of a Moonlane allows the kuuhenki to dodge the blow... and now it's spiraling around its foe in circles!
One loop... Two loops...! The robot's screen is bugging out — it's getting dizzy!
What the... The Rimehorn Deer's antlers are glowing!
It absorbs the kuuvahki from its opponent... and uses that same power to deal a devastating counter attack!
There goes the robot's formation!
Beep.
And... it's the empowered state!
Both robots empowered now... the attack comes in, but oh! Attacks repelled! Opposites attract, but likes repel, and now you've seen it in action!
What a powerful repulsion! The robot crashes into the wall! Can it keep going?
Stacko...!
Stacko is down for the count. Our winner is... the Moon Goddess! Uh, the slightly taller one, I mean.
You did your best, Stacko. I'll take you to Aino's for a checkup right away, don't you worry.
Beep...
*sigh* Well, you beat me fair and square, I guess... Honestly, I underestimated you. Won't make that mistake again.
I think my partner deserves most the credit.
Hmm... Just you wait! When I'm a little bit older, I'm gonna come back a whole lot stronger! Be ready for a rematch!
Hmm...
Defend.
They choose defense! But Stacko's about to attack with full force... Is it too little, too late?
Use an item.
Here it comes... a Lakkaberry! ...What could the Moon Goddess be planning now? Frankly, I don't have a clue, so... your guess is as good as mine!
Run away.
No running away! I told you already!
Defend.
Cautious play from the opposing team... This Moon Goddess has come prepared. Where will it go from here?
Use an item.
The other team... throws out a Lakkaberry! Uh... maybe a way of... building rapport between teammates? Or something? ...This is supposed to be a duel, guys!
Run away.
Oh no you don't! There's no escape! Haha!
Hmm, I don't have enough data. Need more samples... But who should I ask for help?
Is this... one of the amusements? Or is it a research project?
Bit of Column A, bit of Column B!
I'm currently running some synchronization tests on these bots...
Basically, you need to press the button to help them successfully obtain the treasure — but you've gotta time it right.
I'll record your data, which will be used to improve the robots' accuracy.
But, Ma'am... I mean, Moon Goddess, don't you think you should take your eye mask off first?
There's no need. I will be alright.
Okay then. Whatever you're comfortable with.
Ready when you are.
Great, then let's begin.
I'll come back later.
Oh, sure. Happy Moon-Prayer Night.
Would you like to try again? I'll record your data, which will be used to improve the robots' accuracy.
Cool! So much useful data... I'm progressing much faster than I expected!
Thank you so much, Moon Goddess.
If this were any other day, I'm sure it would make for a great photo opportunity. But Moon-Prayer Night has rendered my antlers uncomfortably large...
Doesn't it look like... this Rimehorn Deer has two sets of antlers?
And, done! Here, take a look!
...I think it looks quite funny.
Well, Paimon thinks it's super cute!
It looks like... a silly Chic Badger and... a Rimehorn Deer that's about to fall asleep.
Silly? In what way?
Hmm. Maybe I'll stand on the Chic Badger's side instead.
It looks like we've attracted the attention of quite a few animals... Let's make room for them.
Goodness gracious! I've got to go back and tell my kids I took a photo with our great Moon Goddess!
Thank you so much, Moon Goddess!
It's a pity that my good friend, Faurobert is busy working on a training program for Princess Cimest.
If he could've been here, the victory might've been his.
Meow~
Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?
Meow?
I have a fish-flavor one if you'd like?
Meow...
Of course. If you prefer Mint, then Mint it is.
Meow.
Hehe, don't mention it.
I'm gonna come back a whole lot stronger! Be ready for a rematch!
Miss Lyylikki, a kitten's been following you all this time.
Oh. So it has.
Hello there, little kitty. May the moon light your path.
Did Lady Lauma send you? Or was there something you needed?
Meow~
Hmm? You'd like some Moon-Prayer Candies?
Meow~
No?
I believe... it wants that box. The one with the Moon-Prayer Candies in it.
...Ah, I see! Here, kitty, come on. Here you go.
Meow~
Thank you, Lady...
Huh? Mr. Kantor, did you see that young lady dressed as the Moon Goddess? When did she leave?
Sorry, no, I was looking at... Um, I was watching the... cat.
I see...
The resemblance was uncanny... She seemed like the true Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar, the one who guides souls...
Aren't you gonna sleep, winged ones?
No way! This is Moon-Prayer Night. No one sleeps on Moon-Prayer Night!
No one sleeeeeeeps! No one sleeeeeep, sleep-sleep sleep-sleep—
Shush! Be quiet. You're hurting my head with all that racket...
Wait a sec... That's the Moon Goddess. The real Moon Goddess! And she's looking this way...
Idiots! You're blocking her way!
Brother, I've just been through a breakup... Console me, brother. Ease my aching heart.
What was it you told me a while back? "The scent of love is in the air"...
So I thought... but alas, 'twas but the scent of dirt in the ground.
Oh yeah? Well, I'm sorry, but it sounds like your dumb nose is playing tricks on you.
How many times do I have to tell you? When you spin around, look up at the moon! The MOON, got it? Not at me! Do I look like a moon to you!?
Sorry, Teacher!
And... again!
Stop! ...You, at the back. You're behind the beat!
This dance is supposed to be simple! Focus up, or you'll be practicing till next Moon-Prayer Night at this rate! Again!
Lemme guess, you're angry because of what I said, right? I can tell, because now you're going too fast! You're ahead of the beat!
Sorry, Teacher... It's so noisy here, I... I can't hear the beat...
Miss Kuuhenki? Um... Are you sure it's no trouble?
Then thank you — yes, we'd love to have you play the accompaniment.
Alright, look sharp everyone! Time to step it up! Show me your best moves!
Five, six, seven, eight!

flow.stepDescription: Continue enjoying Moon-Prayer Night, or talk to Paimon

dialogs.text: This was the most fun I've ever had on a Moon-Prayer Night.
Everywhere I went, people were saying "welcome home." And there were friends at every turn.
I only wish it could last longer than one night.
Oh...
Your friends will always be here.
Yes. You're right. I...
Ah, the Moon-Prayer Blossoms...
Ooh, look, look!
Moon-Prayer Night has come!
The moon... It's so beautiful...
Happy Moon-Prayer Night, dear.
Happy Moon-Prayer Night!
Happy Moon-Prayer Night.
Hmph...
Time flies when you're having fun...
Hmm...
Looks like the time has come.
Columbina...
You're heading off, then...?
Yes... To the ruins you mentioned. And from there... back home to the moon.
...Wait!
Aino?
At least... at least...!
Take one of our Craftshop's krumkakes up to the moon with you... Y'know, for a snack!
Haha... Sure. Why not?
The Curatorium of Secrets believes in proper farewells. No story should be left without a satisfactory end note.
Nefer...
Farewells are an important affair for the Ratniki, too. We never know when we might meet again.
Haha... And here I thought grand farewells wouldn't suit tonight's mood. But I suppose friendly passion is not to be stopped, eh?
Hehe, we made a little something for you, Columbina!
Tada!
Oh no...
A Moon-Prayer Night greeting card — with drawings by all of your friends.
You did mention that you'd like a portrait done, so I took the liberty of creating one for you.
I, meanwhile, did the portrait of Mr. Albedo, and Mr. Varka did the same for me.
I mean, I think my work was pretty true to life, don't you think?
The picture of Ashru was my doing. The two of you seemed to get along rather well.
Wait, was I the only one who did a full-body picture? Ugh... That's so embarrassing...
I did the pictures of me and Ineffa!
I did my own portrait and one for Hat Guy.
Plus, there's the two mages, Arlecchino, and Sandrone... So if you ever miss us, just flip the card open, and we'll all be right there with ya!
I don't know what to say... Thank you so much, everyone... This whole Moon-Prayer Night was more than I could've ever asked for... It is the greatest gift I have ever received.
Ah! Lauma. I've figured it out.
Hmm? Figured what out...?
Remember how the Frostmoon Scions used to use milk as invisible ink to write hidden messages?
That was a very long time ago... Oh! Are you saying...?
Yes. When I miss you all, I shall use moonlight in the same way, to write words that only you can see upon the moon itself.
Wow! That sounds lovely.
Quite, but... How will we see them...?
Simply open your windows on nights when the moon shines bright, and the moonlight will naturally flow towards the words I have written.
That sounds most fitting indeed. Very true to form.
I'll... try to write them in places that won't disturb your sleep.
I, for one, would sleep all the better for having read one of your messages before settling down for the night.
Exactly! So don't worry about disturbing anyone's sleep. Just promise you'll write to let us know you're okay, alright?
Alright, I promise.
In that case... Columbina.
I'm ready.
Let's go.
Very well. Let's go.
I'll stay with you to the end.

questNarration.text: The scent of exotic candy soon draws over the nearby children, who excited form a line. Before long, everyone is brainstorming new ideas for flavors...
Smoked Fish Steak. Berries and Fried Meat. Rain-soaked Moon-Prayer Blossom.
The stall owner, peppered with expectant gazes on every side, lets his courage soar free, and colorful candies are placed in the box one after another.
Leave
Chestnut rolled a Hamster
Happy Moon-Prayer Night!
Welcome home, Moon Goddess.
O, fair Moon Goddesses...
So you think you know kuuhenki?
Come and check your knowledge with this kuuhenki quiz!
Cool!
I'm in!
Question 1...
What are kuuhenki? Are they:
The Moon Goddess's Pets? Her familiars? Or...
...Incarnations of the Moon Goddess Herself?
I know, I know!
They're pets!
Noooo, it's incarnations!
Umm... familiars?
The correct answer is... familiars.
Now then, here's the next question...
Which hobby do kuuhenki enjoy? Is it...
Playing musical instruments?
Fishing in the sea?
Or dancing?
I know, I know!
It's playing musical instruments! I know 'cause I just saw!
Wait, I thought it was dancing?
They like all three!
The correct answer is... playing musical instruments.
This Moon Goddess is very observant indeed.
Now then, here's the next question...
If you meet a kuuhenki, what should you do?
Follow their guidance?
Make friends with them?
Or help them solve a problem?
All three!
I'd make friends!
I think all three as well!
The correct answer is... all three!
Kuuhenki like to guide people...
So if you do meet one, it's can't hurt to follow here and see what happens!
But as gentle-hearted Moon Goddesses...
Be sure to be kind to every kuuhenki you meet...
Dodoco's awesome adventure is about to begin! We wish everyone a wonderful journey!
Wow, this looks like so much fun!
I wanna ride too! Let's go together!
That was so fun!
Great!
Woohoo!
I wanna go again!
Dodoco's the best!
Dodoco's awesome adventure has come to a close. We look forward to seeing you again soon!
I'm afraid of heights...
How about... we ride together?
Wow! It looks really fun!
I like sunny days!
Hmm... the day or the night...
Robot, reinforce the armor with kuuvahki! Ha, let's see you try to hit me now!
You sneaky old geezer! Fine, I'll play along. Robot, open those eyes wide and give it a good scare!
Beep beep! (Defense boosted!)
Beep beep! (The opponent's defense is down!)
Which one should Paimon choose?
Okay, this one it is!
I'm going with this one!
I'll pick this one.
We should have two flagons of Magic Tonic to celebrate!
Woohoo, that was fun!
I didn't even win one round...
Yes! I finally won!
Cranberry rolled a Hamster
Cranberry rolled a Paper Frog
Cranberry rolled a Flying Squirrel
Estampe rolled a Hamster
Estampe rolled a Paper Frog
Estampe rolled a Flying Squirrel

The Moon Goddess rolled a Paper Frog
The Moon Goddess rolled a Flying Squirrel
Ding dong. The next robot show will start in five minutes. We thank you for your patience.
The robot show will now begin.
Please welcome to the stage "Cool Your Jets Ducky."
Combining precision engineering with water-cooling technology, this high-performance sprinkler fires powerful, controlled balls of water for up to fourteen seconds at a time.
As well as providing accurate plant-watering at range, it can also be used to clean those tough-to-reach areas of the house that Aino cannot get to, no matter how high she jumps.
Show us what you can do, Cool Your Jets Ducky.
Now that's what I call true power. What a demonstration.
Dealing with stage waterlogging... Task complete.
Next up, we have "Knuckle Duckle."
This armed domestic robot utilizes multi-sensor fusion technology to provide 24-hour security and environmental parameter monitoring.
Duster Mode redefines the meaning of dusting, providing our Krumpanions with a holistic, thorough, and effective cleaning service for the long term.
Take it away, Knuckle Duckle.
Now that's what I call true power. What a demonstration.
Clearing stage of Kuuvahki Stamping Die... Task complete.
Now, let's see what "Krum-Clank 70% Sweet" can do for you.
This dessert-making robot fully automates the baking process with smart recipe analysis and precision temperature control.
Don't miss out on Krum-Clank's taste-testing function. Unique to the market, it is a hallmark of Aino's forward-thinking design philosophy, which places mechanical empathy at the core.
Krum-Clank 70% Sweet, the stage is yours.
Now that's what I call true power. What a demonstration.
Converting excess desserts into energy... Conversion complete.
Now showcasing "Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1."
This stealth robot boasts silent propulsion and low-center-of-gravity stabilization technology, enabling rapid infiltration into high-risk environments.

For obstacle removal on a large scale, it represents an upgrade from more traditional cleaning units. However, it is not recommended for bedroom use as the spinning circular saw may cause damage to furniture.
Over to you, Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1.
Now that's what I call true power. What a demonstration.
Activating kuuvahki acceleration field... Activation complete.
The next showcase is everyone's favorite prospector bot, "Chard Lombro."
I'm not a "prospector bot"! I'm the "Trash King"!
This is a special sorting bot that can sift through useless trash and pick out valuable treasure.
Its manufacturing history remains a mystery, but Aino and I are both delighted that it has joined the Craftshop family.
I'm not!
Now, how about a demo, "Chard"?
How about some trash to sort!? There's none here!
Note how it can simulate temper tantrums and respond to information in real time.
Take me back to the workshop! I want to work!
Now that's what I call true power. What a demonstration.
Now syncing navigation route with Little Chard... Sync complete.
This time, we are proud to present... "Ineffa." That's me.
I am a multifunctional robot for domestic application, integrating smart cleaning, precision cooking, emotive communication, and various other modules.
When necessary, I can autonomously deploy the multipurpose smart assistance unit, "Birgitta," to ensure the safety of important personnel.
...This includes the just-in-time pickup of candy wrappers and similar items, to prevent Aino from tripping over them.
Ineffa! You weren't supposed to mention that!
Acknowledged. Proceeding to demonstration phase.
And we don't need a Birgitta demo! Everyone's seen her already!
Roger. Amending demonstration program... Moonlane detected. Kuuvahki ready.
Aino, let's go home.
W—Wait, that's not what I meant...!
Paimon picked Luonnotar and hid her in a box.
You secretly hid Luonnotar in a box.
You secretly hid Luonnotar in a box.
Ineffa picked Luonnotar and hid her in a box.
It seemed Aino couldn't form a pair with the kuuhenki, so she hid it back into a box.
And the winner is Chestnut! Congratulations!
And the winner is Estampe! Well done!
And the winner is Cranberry! Bravo!
And the winner is... the Moon Goddess! Congratulations!
